title: redkiln-migrate differential report
description: AC-448's per-(kind, slot) counts, AC-467's corpus SHA and tool version, and AC-468's three DISTINCT counts. There is deliberately no `total`: a report that presents only a combined total, or folds lifted-with-loss into lifted, must fail validation.

corpus_sha.description: The corpus pin this tool was built against (AC-467).

per_kind_slot.description: One row per (kind, slot). v0 emits one row per kind with slot = "body"; see src/report.rs's header for why the arithmetic forbids more.

kind.description: A companion wire name, an item record kind, or the legacy configuration kind (s7d §7d.11 step (4)).

slot.description: The named sub-part of the kind this row counts.

lifted.description: Carried whole. NOT a sum: folding lifted_with_loss in here is the form AC-468 refuses.

lifted_with_loss.description: Carried with a migration-loss marker. A distinct count, never folded into lifted.
